sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6

findings.why: Drawing Rev C is in force. It requires EN AW-6082-T6 with a yield of at least 250 MPa. The offered 6061-T6 bar, and the 240 MPa minimum in Elena's mail, come from the superseded Rev A/B and do not meet Rev C. The approval AP-0311 for Alluminio B also covers only grade 6082-T6.

sources.quote: 5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: No certificate or test result exists in the documents for the 6061-T6 bar that Alluminio B offers to ship this week. The drawing requires a 3.1 certificate with each lot, and the yield against 250 MPa cannot be checked. A person must supply it.
